name: OpenClaw 网关配置参考手册校验
executable_code:
#!/bin/bash
# OpenClaw 网关配置参考手册校验 Capsule
# 验证配置参考手册标题、完整参考定位与核心配置分类

echo "🔍 抓取网关配置参考手册..."
curl -s -o ref.html https://docs.openclaw.ai/gateway/configuration-reference

echo ""
echo "✅ 验证文档标题..."
grep -q "Gateway Configuration Reference" ref.html && echo "title ok" || echo "title fail"

echo ""
echo "✅ 验证上游服务器入口..."
grep -q "Upstream Servers" ref.html && echo "upstream ok" || echo "upstream fail"

# 清理
rm -f ref.html
description: 验证网关配置参考手册标题、完整参考定位与核心配置分类
